title: Survey field guide
summary: Move markers, record observations and keep a local survey.

blocks.text: This bounded survey is a small shared map. Each marker has its own observation counter. Time advances only when you choose an action or press Advance one tick.

items: Choose Seats to create one to four views. Choose Keyboard seat to select your marker.
Use Move left or Move right. To use the keyboard, click a view, hold Right/D or Space and press Advance one tick. Right/D moves; Space records an observation.
Record observation adds one to your selected marker’s counter. Swapping the first two targets preserves their observations.

blocks.text: Save survey state keeps positions, counters and tick on this device. Load survey state restores that save and releases held input. A page reload starts a fresh survey; choose Load survey state to return to your saved observations.
Zoom in this view and Zoom out this view affect the selected seat. Reset this view restores its initial scale. Split and Shared change how the views are arranged; they do not change the survey state.
